items.stem: When normalising a target's EBITDA for a valuation, which adjustment is MOST appropriate?

options.text: Adding back a one-time, non-recurring legal settlement expense
options.rationale: Correct: genuinely non-recurring items are added back so EBITDA reflects ongoing earning power.

options.text: Removing ordinary recurring salaries of production staff
options.rationale: Recurring operating costs are not normalisation add-backs.

options.text: Capitalising routine monthly rent as a one-time item
options.rationale: Routine rent is a recurring operating expense, not a one-time item.

options.text: Adding projected synergies not yet realised
options.rationale: Unrealised buyer synergies do not belong in the target's standalone normalised EBITDA.

items.explanation: Correct: genuinely non-recurring items are added back so EBITDA reflects ongoing earning power.

items.stem: A banker on a registered IPO receives a reporter's request for the issuer's growth outlook during the quiet period. What is the appropriate action?

options.text: Decline to make statements that could condition the market outside the prospectus
options.rationale: Correct: offering communications are restricted; information should be confined to permitted channels such as the prospectus.

options.text: Share the internal projection model to be transparent
options.rationale: Disseminating non-public projections during the offering is improper gun-jumping.

options.text: Forward the request to research for a quick rating
options.rationale: This risks improper research involvement in the offering.

options.text: Post the outlook on the banker's social media
options.rationale: This is an unauthorised offering communication.

items.explanation: Correct: offering communications are restricted; information should be confined to permitted channels such as the prospectus.

items.stem: A deal team wants to bring a research analyst 'over the wall' to help with a potential transaction. Which TWO controls are central to doing this appropriately? (Select TWO)

options.text: Documenting the wall-crossing and restricting the analyst's related activity while in possession of material non-public information
options.rationale: Correct: wall-crossings are logged and the recipient is restricted appropriately.

options.text: Obtaining compliance involvement before sharing material non-public information
options.rationale: Correct: information-barrier procedures require compliance oversight of wall-crossings.

options.text: Letting the analyst immediately publish a favourable report to support the deal
options.rationale: Publishing to support a deal is a conflict and misuse of the barrier.

options.text: Sharing the information firm-wide to ensure consistency
options.rationale: Broad dissemination defeats the information barrier.

options.text: Allowing the analyst to trade the issuer's stock personally
options.rationale: Personal trading on MNPI is prohibited.

items.explanation: Correct: wall-crossings are logged and the recipient is restricted appropriately. Correct: information-barrier procedures require compliance oversight of wall-crossings.
